in_hebrew.name: שרינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Lady, Noblewoman, or Princess derives from the Hebrew root 'shar' meaning 'to sing' and 'rachamim' meaning 'mercy'. The name Sarene signifies a noblewoman who sings praises to the Lord with mercy.

in_greek.name: Σαρενή
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Sarene in Greek is derived from the word 'sarx' meaning 'flesh' or 'body', and 'rhein' meaning 'to flow'. The name Sarene signifies a beautiful and radiant woman, as if her flesh or body was flowing with the beauty and grace of the Lord.

in_latin.name: Sarena
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Sarene in Latin is derived from the word 'sar' meaning 'scarlet' or 'red', and 'valere' meaning 'to be well' or 'to be in good health'. The name Sarene signifies a precious and valuable woman, whose beauty and health remind us of the preciousness and health-giving qualities of the Lord.
